stories.title: Introducing LifeSciBench
stories.summary: Introducing LifeSciBench, an expert-authored, expert-reviewed benchmark for evaluating how AI systems handle real-world life science research tasks and decisions.

stories.title: Fiery data hint that controlled forest fires benefit human health
stories.summary: Nature, Published online: 17 June 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01868-zAnalysis of wildfire in California suggests a net reduction in exposure to blaze-related air pollution.

stories.title: Probing picometre-scale interlayer deformations via hyperbolic polaritons
stories.summary: Nature, Published online: 17 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10638-wA new polaritonic optical method that uses the mid-infrared out-of-plane hyperbolic polaritons mode is described and experimentally validated to allow the examination of picometre-scale interlayer deformations, providing a bridge between nanomechanics and photonics.

stories.title: A near-autonomous AI chemist improves a challenging reaction in medicinal chemistry
stories.summary: OpenAI and Molecule.one show how a near-autonomous AI chemist using GPT-5.4 improved a key drug-making reaction, advancing medicinal chemistry research.
